permission_semantics_repair.decision: Arm contracts are explicitly non-authorizing. Only a separate external authorization receipt may enable model execution.

fatal_integration_conflict.summary: No manifest or authorization receipt can currently satisfy both the new R11 arm-binding requirements and the unchanged R10 static preflight schemas.
details: The wrapper requires execution-manifest bindings for r11_arm_contract_sha256, parent_r10_runner_sha256, and r11_protocol_sha256.
The inherited R10 verify_preflight reconstructs a base manifest and requires exact object equality, so any R11 binding field is rejected as drift.
The inherited R10 authorization verifier requires an exact receipt-key set and has no R11 protocol or arm-contract fields.
The inherited invocation receipt binds the execution manifest and authorization receipt but cannot repair an authorization schema that omits the R11 arm contract.
Therefore the current runner prototype must not be used, even with user permission, until a dedicated R11 static contract is implemented and independently tested.

must_define: an R11 execution-manifest schema with explicit arm, replicate, protocol, parent-runner, bridge-contract, and arm-contract bindings
an external authorization receipt schema binding all 32 manifest and arm-contract hashes
an invocation receipt binding cell_id, manifest, authorization, replicate, arm, and run nonce
a preflight verifier that independently reconstructs the complete R11 manifest
negative tests for omitted arm bindings, cross-arm swaps, self-authorizing contracts, expired receipts, and unauthorized cells
required_fix.after_fix: Re-run the portable static audit; model execution remains separately unauthorized.
